title: ResponderDecision
description: Schema for the headless responder agent's output. The agent proposes exactly one action based on the evidence packet.

incident_id.description: The incident identifier, taken from the evidence packet.

confidence.description: The agent's confidence in the proposed root cause. High confidence (>= 0.8) supports a rollback or fix; lower confidence should escalate.

action.description: The proposed action. Only 'rollback' or 'fix' are actionable by the automation layer; 'escalate' hands the packet to a human.

rationale.description: Explanation of the root cause analysis and why this action was chosen. Reference lines in the evidence packet.

commits_since_deploy.description: Commits that landed since the last known-good deployment.

error_rate_change.description: Summary of error rate changes observed (e.g., '5xx rate on /api/v1/tasks jumped from 0% to 25%').

suspicious_changes.description: Specific files or patterns in the diff that correlate with the error rate change.
